worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.summary: Greatly raise Defense. The thick-wrap variant slows movement. This increase ends when the effect breaks or expires.
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.use.0: Wrap up before eating a burst
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.use.1: Stack Defense in a close-range brawl
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.use.2: Use the visible coat window to make the opponent spend time tearing it off
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.descriptio: The coat lasts about %1$s; the levels are taken back when it is torn off or expires.
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.cocoon.on: Thick coat: Defense +3 levels and a longer coat, at the cost of reduced movement speed while it holds and a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.cocoon.off: Light coat: Defense +2 levels, no slow, a shorter wind-up and cooldown; it shields less but does not hinder movement.
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.growth.0: At level %1$s the coat extends to %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.growth.1: At level %1$s the coat extends further to %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.preference: Thick: Defense +3 levels and a longer coat, but reduced movement speed, a longer wind-up and a longer cooldown; Light: Defense +2 levels, no slow and quicker.
